mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the role-allows-kind gate lets the model invent a successful operation whose caller does not hold any role the matrix permits for the endpoint. The injection forces an Auditor (who has no Applicant role) to succeed at POST /applications, which directly violates LeastPrivilege and the FR-005 auditor-read-only and FR-022 post-no-leak invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleAllowsKindViolation { some op: Operation | op.succeeded = BTrue and op.kind = PostApplications and Applicant not in op.caller.roles and Auditor in op.caller.roles }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the every-successful-state-change-has-an-audit fact lets a successful PATCH exist without a corresponding audit row — exactly the SC-002/SC-008 reconciliation failure that AuditCompleteness/FR-017 are supposed to detect.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissingViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = PatchStatus and op.succeeded = BTrue and no op.audit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the every-audit-entry-has-a-source-op fact lets a fabricated or orphaned audit row exist with no originating operation — the structural analogue of an out-of-band UPDATE or DELETE on the audit log that FR-018 / FR-019 forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | (no op: Operation | op.audit = ae) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the no-self-assignment fact lets auto-assignment hand an application to its own applicant. FR-011 explicitly forbids this — it is the conflict-of-interest backstop for FR-013.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfAssignmentViolation { some a: LoanApplication | some a.assignedOfficer and a.assignedOfficer = a.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the PATCH ownership / transition / not-already-decided / reason-required bundle lets some officer who is NOT the application's assigned officer succeed at deciding it — the SC-005 production-failure mode that FR-012 and OwnershipBasedAccess directly forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatchOwnershipViolation { some op: Operation, t: LoanApplication, u: User | op.kind = PatchStatus and op.succeeded = BTrue and op.target = t and op.caller = u and Officer in u.roles and u != t.assignedOfficer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the GET-by-id ownership check lets a non-owner, non-assigned-officer, non-auditor caller successfully read another applicant's application — exactly the FR-020/FR-021 byte-equivalent privacy invariant the NoInformationLeakage assertion is supposed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_GetLeakViolation { some op: Operation, t: LoanApplication | op.kind = GetApplicationById and op.succeeded = BTrue and op.target = t and op.caller != t.applicant and op.caller != t.assignedOfficer and Auditor not in op.caller.roles }
